items.html: Now, the GAR in her are like three Partzufim, namely KHB, and they are hinted at in the Yod Hey of the general SAG. Now, the first Hey of SAG is Bina of Tevuna, which is the third Partzuf of the general SAG, and it has three Heys in it: one corresponding to her GAR, one corresponding to her VAK, and one corresponding to her Malchut.
